item.title: ARM, RISC-V, and AI
item.description: Three questions on the ARM vs. RISC-V battle — what RISC-V actually has going for it in the AI era, why ARM is now making its own SoC, and where RISC-V still has ground to cover.

item.title: Computer Architecture Is Entering a Golden Era
item.description: AI-native workloads, edge fragmentation, and faster experimentation are pushing architecture back to the center of hardware value creation.

item.title: Semiconductor Development Cycles Will Shrink Faster Than Expected
item.description: As prototyping, validation, and silicon feedback loops shrink from months to days, chip development will start to move at a cadence much closer to software.
